title: Clustering estimate for cylinder masses at the points of a fibre (Simon 8.5.10, printed (8))
statement: For all N, n ∈ ℕ, K ≥ 0 and m ∈ ℕ there are c ≥ 0 and δ_m > 0 such that: for δ ∈ (0,δ_m], ε ∈ (0,δ⁴], every Borel measure μ on ℝ^N, P ∈ G(N,n), x ∈ ℝ^N and finite s ⊆ ℝ^N with #s ≤ m, if every y ∈ s satisfies p_P(y) = x, |y − p_P(y)| < ε, (M_y) r ↦ e^{εr}μ(B_r(y))/r^n is non-decreasing on (0,1), and (C_y) μ(U^τ_σ(y))/σ^n ≤ μ(U^{2τ}_ρ(y))/ρ^n + Kερ/τ for 0 < τ ≤ 1, 0 < σ ≤ ρ < 1 (U^τ_σ(y) := B_σ(y) ∩ {z : |(z − y) − p_P(z − y)| < τ}), then for all σ, τ with 0 < σ ≤ δ², 2δ²σ ≤ τ and 4τ ≤ |y − y'| for all distinct y, y' ∈ s: Σ_{y∈s} μ(U^τ_σ(y))/σ^n ≤ (1 + cδ²)μ(B_1(x)) + cδ² in [0,∞].
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (K : ℝ) (m : ℕ), 0 ≤ K → ∃ c δm : ℝ, 0 ≤ c ∧ 0 < δm ∧ ∀ δ ε : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ δm → 0 < ε → ε ≤ δ ^ 4 → ∀ (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (P : Grassmannian N n) (x : Euclidean N) (s : Finset (Euclidean N)), s.card ≤ m → (∀ y ∈ s, Grassmannian.project P y = x ∧ ‖y - Grassmannian.project P y‖ < ε ∧ MonotoneOn (fun r : ℝ ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (ε * r)) * μ (closedBall y r) / ENNReal.ofReal r ^ n) (Ioo 0 1) ∧ ∀ τ σ ρ : ℝ, 0 < τ → τ ≤ 1 → 0 < σ → σ ≤ ρ → ρ < 1 → μ (closedBall y σ ∩ {z | ‖(z - y) - Grassmannian.project P (z - y)‖ < τ}) / ENNReal.ofReal σ ^ n ≤ μ (closedBall y ρ ∩ {z | ‖(z - y) - Grassmannian.project P (z - y)‖ < 2 * τ}) / ENNReal.ofReal ρ ^ n + ENNReal.ofReal (K * ε * ρ / τ)) → ∀ σ τ : ℝ, 0 < σ → σ ≤ δ ^ 2 → 2 * δ ^ 2 * σ ≤ τ → (∀ y ∈ s, ∀ y' ∈ s, y ≠ y' → 4 * τ ≤ ‖y - y'‖) → ∑ y ∈ s, μ (closedBall y σ ∩ {z | ‖(z - y) - Grassmannian.project P (z - y)‖ < τ}) / ENNReal.ofReal σ ^ n ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (1 + c * δ ^ 2) * μ (closedBall x 1) + ENNReal.ofReal (c * δ ^ 2)
